This points to a release-related capture or image-processing issue, rather than a broad KYC deterioration across platforms and document types.","supporting_metrics":[{"name":"Overall KYC approval rate (Sep 1–Oct 31 baseline vs Nov 1–Dec 15 recent)","baseline_value":0.89211,"anomaly_value":0.837695,"unit":"fraction","sql":"SELECT CASE WHEN decision_date < DATE '2025-11-01' THEN 'baseline' ELSE 'recent' END period, SUM(n_approved)*1.0/SUM(n_decisions) rate FROM agg_kyc_daily WHERE decision_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-12-15' GROUP BY 1"},{"name":"Android national-ID KYC approval rate (pre-5.27 vs post-5.27 release date)","baseline_value":0.88809,"anomaly_value":0.692246,"unit":"fraction","sql":"SELECT CASE WHEN decision_date < DATE '2025-11-10' THEN 'pre_5.27' ELSE 'post_5.27' END period, SUM(n_approved)*1.0/SUM(n_decisions) rate FROM agg_kyc_daily WHERE platform='android' AND doc_type='national_id' AND decision_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-09-01' AND DATE '2025-12-15' GROUP BY 1"},{"name":"Android national-ID doc_unreadable rejections (Sep–Oct baseline vs Nov–Dec recent)","baseline_value":155,"anomaly_value":906,"unit":"count","sql":"SELECT platform, doc_type, reject_reason, CASE WHEN month < TIMESTAMP '2025-11-01' THEN 'baseline' ELSE 'recent' END period, SUM(n_rejections) n FROM agg_kyc_reject_reasons_monthly WHERE month BETWEEN TIMESTAMP '2025-09-01' AND TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01' AND platform='android' AND doc_type='national_id' AND reject_reason='doc_unreadable' GROUP BY 1,2,3,4"},{"name":"Android app version 5.27 release date","baseline_value":null,"anomaly_value":null,"unit":"date","sql":"SELECT version, platform, release_date FROM stg_app_releases WHERE platform='android' AND version=5.27"}],"recommended_action":"ROLLBACK_RELEASE","reasoning_summary":"Overall KYC approval moved from 0.89211 in the Sep–Oct baseline to 0.837695 in Nov–Dec. The clearest break is Android national-ID: approval was 0.88809 before the Nov 10 release and 0.692246 after it. In that slice, doc_unreadable rejections increased from 155 to 906; iOS national-ID and other Android document types do not show a comparable approval collapse. Roll back or hotfix Android 5.27 and verify image capture/readability before re-release."}
